name: Invoice chaser
tagline: Chases every unpaid invoice each Friday with a short, polite email in your voice — you approve the batch first.
who: Founders and finance leads who invoice customers and hate the awkward follow-up.
how: Each Friday the agent reads the open invoices, drafts one reminder per customer in your voice, and asks you to approve the batch. Approved drafts go out from your mailbox; replies land in a sheet with the state of each invoice.

schedules.title: Chase unpaid invoices
schedules.prompt: Run the invoice-chaser skill: read the tracker, draft one reminder per overdue invoice, ask for approval of the batch, then send the approved ones.
